body: Taiwan's Ministry of National Defense, citing Defence Blog, reported that US defense technology startup Cummings Aerospace recently used a vehicle-mounted launcher to launch its 3D-printed Hellhound S3 drone, testing the aircraft's performance and deployment flexibility as it seeks potential international customers. On August 25, the team used a launcher mounted on a Polaris utility vehicle and capable of carrying eight drones to launch two Hellhound S3 aircraft in turn at a drone training site in Pendleton, Oregon, for autonomous flight tests.

During the tests, operators used a single handheld system to control both drones through maneuvers at different speeds, altitudes and routes, receiving flight data and meeting all expected objectives. According to Cummings Aerospace, the Hellhound S3 is a multi-role unmanned system built with 3D printing and commercial off-the-shelf components, powered by a turbojet engine with a top speed of 618 kilometers per hour and a range of more than 60 kilometers; it can serve as a loitering munition, precision-guided weapon, one-way attack drone or counter-drone interceptor, and operators can switch modes in two minutes without tools. The company also plans to enter the drone in the US Army's Low Altitude Stalking and Strike Ordnance (LASSO) programme competition.
en.summary: US defense startup Cummings Aerospace has test-launched its 3D-printed Hellhound S3 drone from a vehicle-mounted launcher, controlling two aircraft with a single handheld system, and plans to enter the US Army's LASSO programme competition.
en.title: US startup tests truck-launched 3D-printed Hellhound S3 drone, eyes US Army programme

body: 國防部引述軍聞網站Defence Blog報導指出，美國國防科技新創公司康明斯航太近期利用車載發射裝置，發射旗下以3D列印技術打造的「地獄犬S3」無人機，驗證其性能與部署彈性，可望爭取潛在國際用戶青睞。測試於8月25日在奧勒岡州彭德爾頓一處無人機訓練場進行，團隊運用安裝在「北極星」多用途越野車上、可搭載8架無人機的發射箱，先後發射2架「地獄犬S3」，進行自主飛行測試。

測試期間，操作人員僅透過1組手持系統，順利操控2架無人機完成不同速度、高度和路徑的飛行機動，並回傳相關數據資料，達成所有預期目標。康明斯航太資料顯示，「地獄犬S3」以3D列印與現成商規零組件製成，具低成本與緊湊體型優勢，以渦輪噴射發動機為動力，最高飛行速度可達時速618公里、最大航程逾60公里；該機可擔負滯空攻擊彈藥、精確導引武器、單向攻擊無人機或反無人機攔截器任務，操作人員無須工具，即能在2分鐘內完成不同模式切換。該公司另規劃以該型裝備投入美國陸軍「低空追蹤打擊彈藥」計畫競標。
zh.summary: 美國國防科技新創公司康明斯航太以車載發射箱試射3D列印「地獄犬S3」無人機，單一手持系統同時操控2架完成不同速度、高度與路徑的機動，未來將投入美陸軍低空追蹤打擊彈藥計畫競標。
zh.title: 美新創車載發射3D列印「地獄犬S3」無人機，搶攻美陸軍標案
